reason: The proxy's direction makes more friction read better. The EVOLUTION row and commit 4a80fdf report 'R17 PASS incl. mu 0.087/0.12/0.15', and in that table every load figure falls as friction rises: twist 4.01 -> 3.58 -> 3.42 -> 3.28 deg, M_GH 0.127 -> 0.101 N.m, cuff force 0.58 -> 0.44 N. The bound in the other direction (audit, same judge) reads 4.50 / 4.90 deg. The verdict still passes, so nothing is mis-ranked. But a friction column whose numbers improve with mu is the wrong physics on its face, and a reader of the EVOLUTION row sees a 1.7 deg twist margin at mu 0.15 where the bound shows 0.10 deg. Proposed catalogue entry R5: a one-sided proxy (a stand-in applied in the direction that helps) reported as a pass at the worse condition. Detect it when a column improves monotonically with a parameter that physically worsens it; the fix is to report both strokes' bounds.

reason: The held-out fold margin is held by the stop only if K is on its law, and the built drive lags. The 5 deg rule reads th, and the J2 stop sits on J2's own angle. th also moves with K, about 0.08 deg of margin per deg of K. The red team measured the as-built drive's systematic K lag at -0.42 to -0.53 deg (arm compliance, follower clearance, wear), with +-0.24 deg random on top. At a lag of -0.1 / -0.5 / -0.7 deg the held-out minimum is 4.998 / 4.966 / 4.950 deg, with 1-2 of 852 taken poses under 5. The bench holds: 5.12 at -0.7 deg, 0 poses under 5. So the rule 'stops engage at >= 5 deg of th in every state' fails by at most 0.05 deg as built without compensation. The verified bench 18.49 does not lean on it; at most 2 held-out poses (<= 0.21 held-out points) do. The fix is in hand: a +0.75 deg K lead (lobe-ring dowel phase +0.35 deg of q2) gives >= 5.003 held out at the worst build. It is in the gen-7 full-CAD builder (pipeline/conformal/param_cad, 'O1 dowel key at the onset phase + 0.35 deg of q2') but not in the judged L1 (no match in pipeline/concept_l1/build_slipper_l1.py or the L1 design.json). The lead's own effect on skin distance and on the score is not measured: a 0.2-0.75 deg K offset moves link 1b's far end by about 0.2-0.8 mm.
